email.subject: Redline Auto Care: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I checked Redline Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no way to book an appointment online, and no click-to-call button on mobile, so people searching for an auto shop on their phone can't reach you with one tap. The footer also still shows an old year, which can make visitors wonder if the site's abandoned.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
